item.title: Find old versions: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool: Privilege Escalation
item.description:
Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool: Privilege escalation · low-privileged account · local access · exploited · end of life

First step: This flaw dates from 2015, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool, and update or retire it.

Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

High · Unsupported · CVE-2015-5287
